name: context-handoff-cutover
description: Tier-P F1 scenario: on a fresh box, install the live-cutover trio and assert the prompt-first handoff contract. It records seed character/token cost, a one-turn/one-tool acknowledgement budget, payload round-trip fidelity, required lifecycle verbs, live pane retirement, and the no-coordinator adopted-anchor fallback. Name-free / public.

provisioned_by_flow: tmux (apt, best-effort for the mechanism phase)

stages.title: compact seed, fidelity, and takeover budget metrics
consume, startup binding, and retire CLI verbs are real
mechanism: retire verb kills a live mux pane (best-effort)
adopted anchor: no-coordinator file fallback and mux resolution
